national.definition: Registered: four-year schools in the national registry (pipeline/registry; scope rule in pipeline/registry.py). Researched: a verified or partially verified deep-dive record, or a queue entry recording an attempt other than not_yet_researched. Covered: meets docs/PROGRAM_DEPTH_COMPLETION.md. Untracked states count as registered only.
